tips.text: Rank the first Akstiletto to 30 before feeding it to the Aksomati or Sarpa; only the first needs ranking.
Build the Tenno Lab in a solo Ghost clan if you have no clan; it is enough for the research.
Build only one Tenno Lab; a second gives no benefit.
Treat it as the easy end of the game; most of the time is waiting on research and build timers.
